name: @spinjs/theme

scripts.schema: bun -e "import { writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises'; import { spinThemeJsonSchema } from './src/contract/schema.ts'; await writeFile('schema.json', JSON.stringify(spinThemeJsonSchema(), null, 2) + '\n');"
scripts.types: bun -e "import { writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises'; import { parseTokens, generateTypes, minimalLanguage } from './src/index.ts'; const parsed = parseTokens(minimalLanguage); if (!parsed.ok) throw new Error(parsed.error); await writeFile('src/theme-types.d.ts', generateTypes(parsed.tree));"

description: The value layer: DTCG parsing, validation, gates, design languages, and facets.
